execution: Not run in this lane; independent source review and the root-owned admitted native browser run remain required. Runtime output is ignored test-results/debug-log-controls-acceptance.json.
profile: The existing owned-profile harness creates a disposable profile and removes it after execution; clear is scoped to that run only.
event_source: Runner compares actual scoped debug-event rows before and after natural public-page navigation/click. It does not write to the debug store or inject events. A missing positive event set keeps event-dependent targets unverified.
credentials: The runner mirrors the proven isolated-admin-signin-acceptance.mjs real UI sequence because that script is an executable entrypoint: open Settings Account, navigate the real web login form, read AI_ADMIN_USERNAME/AI_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the aidream env only when the form is ready, submit through the web UI, click extension Sign in, and verify exact account email, admin role, and Sign out in the real Settings UI. No auth storage injection, credential logging, or raw auth error reporting is used.
evidence: Runtime 003 exercised the warm profile: the real detail row expanded and collapsed, and a natural error badge cleared, while detail-only search lacked a usable natural key. This source-only follow-up adds DEBUG_RELOAD_BEFORE_CONTROLS=1: after the same real admin UI login, the owned side panel receives Page.reload, its main-frame loader ID must change, and Settings Account must again display the exact admin identity before natural event generation and the same control checks. Every receipt names warm or post_real_panel_reload; unrun dimensions and service-error remain unverified. The detail-search probe now prefers a displayed JSON key, then a displayed primitive JSON string/number, requiring one occurrence in the actual detail text and absence from every observed message. The private term is typed through trusted input and the original detail row must survive the filter; no term or event payload is written to receipts. Existing warm runtime receipts remain immutable. Runtime 004 independently exercised the post-real-panel-reload branch and remains immutable; this additional branch does not relabel those warm or reload observations. Search reset now carries an explicit exact prior-count assertion in its private result.
limitations: No service-error browser execution occurred in this source-only lane; root-owned admitted runtime and independent source review are required.
The read-only /health probe is intentionally silent in the Debug event log on failure. A visible FAIL and actual network failure do not prove a corresponding error row or badge.

If an online 200/OK positive control or offline loading failure/FAIL is absent, the service-error dimension remains unverified; the runner still restores the owned target network before ordinary controls.
T14 detail search remains unverified if naturally displayed JSON supplies no unique key or primitive value absent all observed messages.
T17 error-badge clearing requires a natural positive badge before Clear; the runner does not create one.

service_error_scenario.source_path: Debug Bridges Channel A Send test ping invokes pingHealth, which issues a read-only GET /health from the side-panel target and displays OK or FAIL. The health helper uses silent request errors, so this does not prove an error log row or badge.
service_error_scenario.proof: The runner captures one actual panel-target GET /health with HTTP 200 and visible OK before applying target-scoped CDP offline conditions. It then requires one same-URL GET with a Network.loadingFailed event and visible FAIL. Cache is disabled during the two probes; network and cache settings are restored in finally before the existing natural-event Debug controls run. No response mock, event insertion, service write, Chat/Pilot, or global network change is used.
service_error_scenario.privacy: The health URL is held only in memory for exact request matching; result fields contain booleans and fixed stage/categories, never URL, response body, credentials, or event text.
service_error_scenario.evidence_scope: A successful probe establishes an actual service-error precondition for the subsequent search, pause/resume, clear and detail checks. It does not itself establish a service-error Debug event or positive error badge; T17 badge-clearing remains independently conditional on an observed badge before Clear.
